data.title: Joint Statement of the Government of Canada and the Bank of Canada on the Renewal of the Monetary Policy Framework
data.author: Department of Finance Canada
data.summary: The Government of Canada and the Bank of Canada jointly review and renew the Bank’s monetary policy framework every five years. The Bank then independently conducts monetary policy to achieve the framework’s goals. The Government and the Bank agree that monetary policy must work to promote the economic and financial well being of Canadians. We also agree that the best way monetary policy can do this is by keeping inflation low, stable, and predictable, thereby protecting Canadians from large increases in the cost of living. A credible and well understood monetary policy framework that focuses on price stability helps the economy grow, supports investment and job creation, and fosters confidence in Canada’s economy.

https://www.canada.ca/en/department-fina.label: Joint Statement of the Government of Canada and the Bank of Canada on the Renewal of the Monetary Policy Framework

data.author: Immigration, Refugees and Citizenship Canada
data.summary: An immigration system that is well-managed, efficient and focused on our economic needs is key to building Canada strong. Every year, Canada tables an immigration levels plan outlining the targets for temporary and permanent resident admissions for the next three years. Last year and through Budget 2025, we committed to taking back control over the immigration system and putting Canada on a trajectory to bring immigration back to sustainable levels.

data.summary: The Law Commission of Canada (LCC) is pleased to announce the publication of the first volume of papers in its Charity and Law in Canada project. data.title: Federal government marks continued progress on the Ontario Line
data.author: Housing, Infrastructure and Communities Canada
data.summary: Today the Government of Canada marked another milestone in the construction of the Ontario Line as the first tunnel boring machine (TBM) broke through to the future King West Station in downtown Toronto. This represents the first time a TBM has reached a station on the new subway line. Once complete, the Ontario Line is expected to accommodate nearly 390,000 daily boardings and bring nearly 230,000 more people within walking distance of rapid transit, while supporting 4,700 jobs annually during construction.

data.title: Statement on the sentencing of Joshua Wong
data.author: Global Affairs Canada
data.summary: “Joshua Wong was sentenced to 10 years' imprisonment following a further charge under the National Security Law (NSL). This comes just months after leaders of the Hong Kong Alliance were convicted under the same legislation. These are further examples of how the NSL is being used to target individuals for political expression and participation. We call for an immediate end to all unjust prosecutions of individuals charged under the NSL and urge the authorities in China and Hong Kong to uphold their international commitments and honour the rights and freedoms guaranteed to the people of Hong Kong under the Sino-British Joint Declaration (1984).”

https://www.canada.ca/en/global-affairs/.label: Statement on the sentencing of Joshua Wong
